s5eDesign.recipientModel: Actor + accepted friends (FRIENDS/PUBLIC). PRIVATE = actor only. Server-derived from SocialConnection ACCEPTED.

s5eDesign.likeEvent: SOCIAL_ACTIVITY_LIKED — only when isNewLike=true (dedup at source)
s5eDesign.unlikeEvent: SOCIAL_ACTIVITY_UNLIKED — only when wasLiked=true (idempotent, no false decrement)
s5eDesign.payloadContract: envelope=[eventId,type,occurredAt,entityId=activityId]. NO likeCount, likedByMe, liker, phone, blockedBy, token.
s5eDesign.restAuthoritative: Client refetches GET /api/social/feed → authoritative likeCount + likedByMe. Socket does NOT carry count.
